policies.in_progress_prerequisites: A course in progress counts toward the prerequisites of courses in the following term.

courses.title: Mechanics
courses.description: Motion, forces, energy, momentum, rotation, and oscillations.

courses.title: Electricity and Magnetism
courses.description: Electric fields, circuits, magnetic fields, induction, and electromagnetic waves.

courses.title: Modern Physics
courses.description: Special relativity, radioactivity, nuclear structure, fission, and criticality. Open to students with high-school physics.

courses.title: Thermal Physics
courses.description: Temperature, heat, entropy, the laws of thermodynamics, and an introduction to statistical mechanics.

courses.title: Astrophysics
courses.description: Stellar structure and evolution, nucleosynthesis, galaxies, and cosmology.

courses.title: Radiation and Health Physics
courses.description: Interaction of radiation with matter, dosimetry, biological effects of radiation, and radiation protection.

courses.title: Quantum Mechanics
courses.description: Early quantum theory and the Bohr model, wave functions, the Schrödinger equation, operators, and the hydrogen atom.

courses.title: Senior Research Project
courses.description: An independent research project supervised by a faculty member, ending in a written report and a talk.

courses.title: Calculus I
courses.description: Limits, derivatives and their applications, and an introduction to integration.

courses.title: Calculus II
courses.description: Techniques and applications of integration, sequences, series, and an introduction to differential equations.

courses.title: Introduction to Poetry
courses.description: Close reading of poems from several periods, with attention to form, meter, imagery, and voice.

courses.title: The Novel
courses.description: Major novels from the eighteenth century to the present and how the form has changed.

courses.title: Modern Europe
courses.description: European political, social, and cultural history from the French Revolution to the end of the Cold War.

courses.title: The Atomic Age
courses.description: The scientists, politics, and weapons of the nuclear age, from the quantum revolution through the early Cold War.
